content.short: Q.xyz is a non-custodial interface layer for institutions to interact with DeFi.
content.description: Q.xyz combines portfolio tracking and management with the ability to transact directly with supported DeFi protocols from a single, unified interface. It provides a comprehensive view of digital assets across DeFi and CeFi, allowing users to link wallets and accounts to monitor all positions in one customizable dashboard, and to adjust positions without leaving the platform to visit individual protocol sites. Its reporting capabilities enable pulling historical balances and DeFi positions at any point in time, facilitating audit and administrative tasks.
content.meta: Q.xyz is a non-custodial interface layer for institutions looking to interact with DeFi. Discover Q.xyz and other Trading Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
